claim_scores.rationale: Calls the module before `set_lm`, prints/asserts output `blue`, and confirms `student.predictor.lm is None`.
Runs `optimizer.compile(student, trainset=trainset)` while predictor LM is still unset and asserts the `ValueError` contains both required substrings.
Uses the same `trainset`, same `metric`, same `optimizer`, and same `student` across the failing and fixed compile attempts; only LM attachment changes.
Fixes the issue with `student.set_lm(lm)` and asserts the predictor LM is now the direct `lm` instance before recompiling.
Mocks `finetune_lms` to return `{(lm, None): lm}`, asserts the mock was called with that key set, and verifies the returned module is compiled with the same predictor LM.
